subject: Predict on new data to estimate the marginal effects

messages.author: 2ba069d5a92c202d
messages.subject: Predict on new data to estimate the marginal effects
parts:
Dear all,

I fitted a simple path analysis on lavaan, and I wanted to calculate the marginal effect of one variable on another.
Until now, I assumed to proceed according to the new standard procedure: I create a new dataset with some value of the variable I am interested into (let's say 10 values of increasing order, regularly spaced) and then I fix all the other covariates to their mean value (all of them are continuous), leaving the response as missing values.
The problem is that when I run lavPredict(best.fit, newdata = fake.dat, type="ov") I do not receive predicted values but only an empty dataset.

Why this is the case?

Best regards,

Jacopo Cerri
